Scene 02

FBI HEADQUARTERS

Blevins

Agent Mulder's latest 302 requesting assignment and travel expenses for the both of you.

Dana Scully

Sioux City, Iowa. That's the first I've heard of it.

Blevins

It came up through channels from Mulder's asac to the district g-14 and onto my desk.

Dana Scully

I don't understand.

Blevins

In essence, Mulder is petitioning the bureau to assign a case number to a tabloid headline.

Dana Scully

He must have more evidence than...

Blevins

Not according to his 302.

Dana Scully

I admit, that is strange... Even for Mulder.

Blevins

Perhaps it has something to do with this. Take a look.

Dana Scully

An x file?

Blevins

Has he shared any of this with you? There's no need to protect him. He's the agent of record. He initiated the file himself.

Dana Scully

She was his sister. She disappeared 21 years ago. He was 12 and she was eight. He claims that he was in the room when it happened. He recalls a bright light outside the window and, uh... And a presence in the room.

Blevins

In your opinion has agent Mulder's personal agenda clouded his professional judgment?

Dana Scully

In my opinion, no.

Blevins

But you can see how it might appear that way. As you know, agent Mulder's preoccupation with fringe matters has been a big source of friction in the bureau. This is another case in point. I'm going to disallow the 302.

Dana Scully

With respect, sir, at least let me talk with him and make a recommendation.

Scene 03

X-FILES OFFICE

Dana Scully

It just doesn't seem... Substantial enough to warrant an investigation.

Fox Mulder

Okay, Scully, so we disagree. It's not the first time, and it won't be the last.

Dana Scully

At least if we had a legitimate source...

Fox Mulder

This is the essence of science. You ask an impertinent question and you're on your way to a pertinent answer.

Dana Scully

What makes this case any more credible than the hundred-year-old mother with the lizard baby?

Fox Mulder

Because the lizard baby wasn't born anywhere near Lake Okobogee.

Dana Scully

Oko-what?

Fox Mulder

Bogee. Okobogee.

Dana Scully

Is that supposed to mean something to me?

Fox Mulder

If you know anything about trout fishing or UFO hot spots.

Dana Scully

Define hot spot.

Fox Mulder

Four sightings in 1967, august including one by a national weather service plane. This is a light-blasted, digitally enhanced enlargement.

Dana Scully

The pilot took that photograph?

Fox Mulder

Try a girl scout with an instamatic. Four of the nine girls in the troop claim to have seen something. Five, if you include the den mother. The air force said it was a weather balloon caught in a wind shear but there wasn't a weather balloon launched that day within 700 Miles. Read me the names of those girl scouts from 1967.

Dana Scully

Lisa terrel, bonnie winston, doreen mccallister, darlene mor--

Fox Mulder

It's the same Darlene Morris.

Scene 04

SIOUX CITY, IA

Dana Scully

Ms. Darlene Morris? I'm agent Scully, and this is agent Fox Mulder. We talked with you on the phone last night.

Darlene Morris

Please, come in. Well, I knew that if I screamed loud and long enough that someone would listen but I never expected the FBI uh, this is kevin. Kevin, say hi. Would you like some coffee? Mmm. Some days, I can't even... Get myself up out of bed and... Kevin has been acting so strange. I don't know what to do anymore. I just want her back again.

Dana Scully

Ms. Morris during the divorce, was there a custody battle?

Darlene Morris

Charles had nothing to do with this.

Dana Scully

How can you be so sure?

Darlene Morris

Because I know what happened. It's just like it was before.

Fox Mulder

Summer of 1967? The girl scout troop?

Darlene Morris

How did you know?

Fox Mulder

Your name's on record at the center for UFO studies in evanston, illinois.

Darlene Morris

Really?

Fox Mulder

Yeah, a pilot for the national weather service made a sighting over the same area on the same day.

Darlene Morris

They took her, didn't they, mr. Mulder?

Fox Mulder

You said that kevin was there the night it happened?

Darlene Morris

He didn't see anything. He was asleep.

Fox Mulder

Do you think I might talk to him anyway? Mmm. Thanks.

Darlene Morris

You know... I've told the story so many times now... Oh, to the newspapers and the police... And every time I tell it people get this look in their eye just like the look that you've got right now.

Fox Mulder

Hey, buddy. You mind if I sit down? Thanks. Your mom tells me you've been having nightmares.

Kevin Morris

I guess so.

Fox Mulder

You want to tell me about them?

Kevin Morris

No. All right.

Fox Mulder

What are you doing? You making something? Can I take a look at it? Thanks.

Kevin Morris

It's coming from there.

Fox Mulder

The TV?

Scene 05

SIOUX CITY SHERIFF'S DEPARTMENT

Fox Mulder

I don't know what it is. May be a binary sequence of some kind. Could be anything, could be nothing. I know you're busy. Look, I know a friend who knows a friend who knows a friend who can get you a ticket to a redskins game. You got it. All right. You know where to find me? Thanks, danny.

As I was telling your partner, we found no evidence of kidnap. No phone call, no ransom note and since we didn't turn up a body...

Fox Mulder

How do you explain what her mother saw?

I think that darlene has a very active imagination. I've been listening to those stories since the first grade.

Fox Mulder

Sioux City Sheriff

Fox Mulder

Sioux City Sheriff

We went out to the campsite. We didn't find anything. Darlene's little girl was no prom queen. I can't count the number of times I pulled her out of parked cars or found her puking her guts out by the side of the road. It was just a matter of time before...

Fox Mulder

Before what?

Sioux City Sheriff

Before something bad happened to her and if darlene needs to make up crazy stories to get past that, fine, but don't tell me to treat it as the truth. I'm not going to waste my time.

Dana Scully

I just think it's a good idea not to antagonize local law enforcement.

Fox Mulder

Who? Me? I'm mr. Congeniality.

Dana Scully

You never know. We might need his help one of these days.

Fox Mulder

I'll send him a bundt cake.

Tessa

You're looking for ruby, right?

Dana Scully

That's right. Who are you?

Tessa

It doesn't matter.

Dana Scully

Are you a friend of ruby's?

Tessa

Ruby didn't have friends. She just had people she liked to hang with.

Dana Scully

And she liked to hang out with you?

Tessa

I guess we had some times.

Fox Mulder

Like the night she disappeared?

Tessa

It was greg. She was supposed to see him that night.

Fox Mulder

Who's greg?

Tessa

Her boyfriend, Greg Randall. They were supposed to meet up at the lake. They had stuff to talk about.

Fox Mulder

What kind of stuff?

Tessa

Greg got ruby pregnant. I don't know, whatever, she got herself pregnant.

Dana Scully

Do you know what they were planning to do about it?

Tessa

They were going to leave town. At least, that's what ruby told me.

Dana Scully

You know greg from school?

Tessa

Greg? School? I don't think so. All he ever did since we met him was pour beer at the pennsylvania pub.
